statement: SDL Switch HIDAPI uses a 30 ms minimum interval for rumble writes and a 50 ms refresh policy for sustaining effects, while queuing and coalescing pending SDL low/high rumble magnitudes.

applicability.revision: source revisions Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e; physical device revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: SDL scheduling constants are host policy and not measured motor envelope, firmware polling rate, or universally required command cadence.
